---
title: "Python plotting smoke test"
jupyter: python3
---

This NumPy and Matplotlib plot is computed during rendering, with no external data.

```{python}
#| label: fig-python-sine
#| fig-cap: "A sine wave generated by Python and Matplotlib."
#| fig-alt: "A blue sine wave over one full cycle from zero to two pi."
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 4
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

x = np.linspace(0, 2 * np.pi, 200)
fig, ax = plt.subplots()
ax.plot(x, np.sin(x), color="#2563eb", linewidth=2)
ax.set(xlabel="x (radians)", ylabel="sin(x)", title="Python: sine wave")
ax.grid(alpha=0.25)
fig.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
